description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Diversified Services Network, Inc. is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer I to develop and test production embedded software for connected devices. The role involves integrating platform components, validating network communications, troubleshooting software on target hardware, and documenting designs and test results.
Entry-Level Embedded Software Engineer developing connected-device software, integrating platform components, and testing network communications on target hardware

Responsibilities:
• Design, code, and test embedded software features for connected devices
• Integrate software components across the platform stack and validate network communication functionality
• Debug and troubleshoot software issues on target hardware
• Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and testing alongside senior engineers
• Document software designs and test results

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering from a U.S.-based institution, completed by December 2026
• Classwork and lab or project experience implementing software for embedded Linux
• Programming experience in C, C++, and/or Rust
• Exposure to Linux middleware and application development
• Working knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, and Wi-Fi networking
• Availability to start in January 2027

Preferred:
• Academic or personal project experience designing entertainment or connectivity-type embedded devices (e.g., infotainment, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/cellular communication software)

Skills:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering from a U.S.-based institution, completed by December 2026

• Working knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, and Wi-Fi networking
• Availability to start in January 2027
• Academic or personal project experience designing entertainment or connectivity-type embedded devices (e.g., infotainment, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/cellular communication software)

Pay: $75K/yr - $80K/yr
